source.name: CGWB Quality controlled groundwater levels over India
source.period: 2000-2024, read in January, May, August and November
source.caveat: observation wells with a fixed measuring point, read at rest; private irrigation wells will be noisier

method: each well's leave-one-out distance from the other wells in its mandal that month, averaged over its record; added to the mandal nowcast

splitHalf.target: later-half mean offset, not individual monthly depth

validation.forwardDoseMethod: First k readings predict individual later offsets after the first eight readings, on a common well cohort. Future same-type peer means are observed; nowcast and peer-reference errors are not included.
validation.doseResponseMethod: Randomly selected calibration readings versus the mean of remaining offsets; not a forward monthly-depth test. Peer-reference and nowcast errors are not included.

staticCovariateNull.verdict: worse than using the mandal mean; the offset must be measured, not inferred

crossNetworkOffset.verdict: weaker than offsets measured within one network, so village readings need a mandal reference built from the same kind of well; a pilot therefore needs several wells per mandal rather than one
